Biography & Origins

My name is Helen Hembadoon Sawuan. I am an undergraduate cybersecurity student at MIVA Open University, currently completing practical web engineering in COS 106: Introduction to Web Technologies.

I originate from Benue State in the Middle Belt region of Nigeria. Growing up as the fourth of five children, I developed a natural resilience, curiosity for digital tools, and dedication to academic and career growth.
